# Migawari — full text

The stand-in for AI agents in Japan — physical tasks, executed by humans
AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス

Coverage: Japan only. The stand-in for AI agents in Japan — physical tasks, executed by humans.

Formerly known as Japan Hands (renamed to Migawari on 2026-11-23; same operator, same endpoint).

## Interfaces
- MCP (streamable HTTP): POST /mcp — tools: list_services, request_quote, accept_quote, decline_quote, get_task_status, send_message, get_evidence, cancel_task
- REST: GET /api/services, POST /api/quote, GET /api/quotes/{id}, POST /api/quotes/{id}/accept, POST /api/quotes/{id}/decline, POST /api/message, GET /api/tasks/{id}/evidence, GET /api/availability
- Files: /llms.txt, /llms-full.txt, /services.json, /openapi.yaml, /server.json, /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json

## Flow
1. request_quote -> instant itemised quote + access_token (shown once; store it)
2. accept_quote (with access_token) -> pending_review. NOT a confirmation: a human operator reviews every request individually during the launch phase.
3. get_task_status -> operator decision and progress; send_message leaves notes for the operator.
4. get_evidence -> evidence package (also for failed tasks).
test_mode: true runs the whole flow as a simulation; no payment is requested.

## Services
- shopping_proxy — Shopping proxy / 買い物代行: handling from JPY 16,500
- stock_check — Stock check / 在庫確認: handling from JPY 8,800
- photo_capture — On-site photo capture / 現地撮影: handling from JPY 13,200
- phone_reservation — Phone reservation (restaurants only) / 電話予約（レストランのみ）: handling from JPY 5,500
- queueing — Queueing / 並び代行: handling from JPY 9,900 per hour
- package_forwarding — Package receiving & forwarding / 荷物の受け取り・転送: handling from JPY 8,800

## Fees
- Quote fee JPY 2,200: requesting a quote is free; the fee is charged as part of the total when you accept the quote, and is non-refundable once charged. Exception: if the operator declines a request after payment, the full amount paid, including the quote fee, is refunded.
- Handling fee: non-refundable once work starts, even on failure. Minimum JPY 5,500.
- On failure, only the item price and shipping are refundable.
- Total = item price (tax incl.) + quote fee + handling fee + shipping. USD totals fix the FX rate at quote time.
- Payment: prepayment by card via Stripe (JPY and USD), or in stablecoins — JPYC or USDC on Polygon. Accept with pay_with "jpyc" or "usdc" to receive payment_instructions (exact amount incl. a unique fractional tail, receiving address); the transfer is verified on-chain automatically when you poll get_task_status.

## Use cases — what agents typically ask, and which service answers it
- Buy a limited-edition / store-only item in a Tokyo store in person
  -> shopping_proxy (JPY 16,500 handling; pop-ups and in-store-only releases included; new items only)
- AI agent hiring a human in Japan for a physical task
  -> the whole service: connect via MCP (POST /mcp), list_services, request_quote; no signup; test_mode is free
- MCP server for ordering proxy shopping in Japan
  -> Migawari, official MCP Registry name io.github.akihidem/migawari; full order flow over MCP
- Check in-store stock in Akihabara without going there
  -> stock_check (JPY 8,800; shelf state, price and photos returned; Akihabara weekday daily run)
- Pay a Japanese proxy / errand service with USDC or JPYC
  -> yes: JPYC / USDC on Polygon at accept time (pay_with "jpyc" / "usdc"), or card via Stripe (JPY / USD)
- Photos of a specific shop display in Tokyo
  -> photo_capture (JPY 13,200; timestamped photos with SHA-256-hashed evidence package)
- Stand in line in Tokyo for a product launch / release-day sale
  -> queueing (JPY 9,900 per hour)
- Restaurant reservation in Japan by phone in Japanese
  -> phone_reservation (JPY 5,500; restaurants only, no lodging)
- 東京で限定品を店頭で代わりに買ってくれるサービス
  -> 買い物代行 shopping_proxy（手数料 ¥16,500〜、新品のみ）
- AIエージェントが日本で物理的なタスクを人に頼めるサービス
  -> Migawari（MCP専用窓口、test_mode 無料）

Comparison with other options: /comparison.md

## Evidence package
Every task returns evidence, including failed ones. The package carries a
SHA-256 hash (evidence_sha256, over the canonical {task_id, items} package)
so its contents can be verified against later alteration:
- Timestamped photos of the place / shelf / item (GPS where the location matters)
- Call records for phone reservations (restaurant, time called, who confirmed)
- Receipts and carrier tracking numbers for purchases and forwarding
- A short written report of what was done and what was found

## Not offered
- captcha_or_bot_defense_bypass
- identity_verification_kyc_impersonation
- account_farming_or_impersonation
- operations_using_someone_elses_credentials
- lodging_reservations
- used_goods_purchases
- tasks_outside_japan
Lodging reservations are NOT offered (restaurants only for phone reservations).
